subject: science
passage: Tiger beetles are among the fastest runners in the insect world relative to their size, and some species cover more than a hundred body lengths a second. At that pace the beetle's eyes cannot gather light quickly enough to form a clear image, so the animal is effectively blind while it runs. To catch anything at all, a hunting beetle depends on three ______ short bursts of speed, frequent stops to relocate its prey, and antennae held rigidly forward to detect obstacles it cannot see. High-speed video shows that the pauses last only a fraction of a second, far too brief for the prey to escape.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

explanation.why: "To catch anything at all, a hunting beetle depends on three tactics" is a complete independent clause, and what follows is a list of the three tactics. A colon after an independent clause is the mark that introduces a list.
explanation.A: Correct. The colon follows the independent clause and introduces the list of three tactics.
explanation.B: Incorrect. A semicolon must be followed by an independent clause, but "short bursts of speed, frequent stops …, and antennae held rigidly forward" is a list with no main verb.
explanation.C: Incorrect. With no punctuation, "three tactics short bursts of speed" runs together and cannot be read clearly.
explanation.D: Incorrect. A period would leave the list "Short bursts of speed … it cannot see" as a sentence fragment.
